free_text: The decision is to defer biopsy because the panel protocol was driven by the EXPERT-LIBRARY precedent, which indicated NO BIOPSY based on an identical panel in the labelled series. This deferral is supported by the prior positive biopsy status and the high-risk PI-RADS 5 finding, which aligns with the Expert-Cohort criterion. The retrieved finding of Gleason 3+4 from the previous notes further supports the management strategy of proceeding with treatment rather than further tissue sampling.
